comparison.objective: Read a routing card and sort parcels into prescribed chutes; candidate adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual mapping and parcel pick-and-place versus recessed tool alignment, fine rotation, counterholding, torque control, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: All parcels in mapped chutes, with any missort scoring zero, versus two acceptable carriage stops without drift or unsafe events.
comparison.reason: Symbolic routing and sorting are unrelated to physical commissioning.
